concepts.title: Limit of a function between metric spaces
concepts.description: For f defined near an accumulation point a of a metric space, lim_{x→a}f(x)=L means that for every ε>0 there is δ>0 such that 0<d(x,a)<δ implies d(f(x),L)<ε.

concepts.title: Galois field extension
concepts.description: An algebraic field extension that is both normal and separable.

concepts.title: General linear group over a commutative ring
concepts.description: The group GL_n(R) of square matrices over a commutative ring R having a two-sided matrix inverse, with matrix multiplication.

concepts.title: Geometric character lattice of a reductive group
concepts.description: For a connected reductive F-group, X*(G)=Hom_(Fsep-groups)(G_Fsep,G_m) with pointwise multiplication and its natural absolute-Galois action. It is a finitely generated free abelian group; its fixed elements are the F-rational characters.

concepts.title: Geometrically connected affine algebraic group
concepts.description: An affine F-group whose coordinate algebra after extension to an algebraic closure has no idempotents other than 0 and 1. This is the coordinate-algebra account of connectedness after base change.

concepts.title: Gradient of a scalar function on Euclidean space
concepts.description: For differentiable f on an open subset of R^n, the vector ∇f=(∂₁f,…,∂ₙf), defined by its coordinate partial derivatives.

concepts.title: Gritsenko–Nikulin’s product formulas for Igusa cusp forms
concepts.description: Write q=e^(2πiz₁), r=e^(2πiz₂), s=e^(2πiz₃), and let f(D) be the discriminant coefficients of φ₀,₁. The integrally normalized Igusa forms satisfy X₁₀=qrs∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(2f(4nm−l²)) and X₃₅=q²rs²(q−s)∏(1−qⁿrˡsᵐ)^(f₂(4nm−l²)), where f₂(N)=8f(4N)+2((−N/2)−1)f(N)+f(N/4), using the Kronecker symbol and f(N/4)=0 unless 4 divides N. Products range over n,m≥0, arbitrary l when n+m>0, and l<0 when n=m=0; they converge near the standard cusp.

concepts.title: Group action on a set
concepts.description: A map G×X→X, written (g,x)↦gx, satisfying ex=x and (gh)x=g(hx).

concepts.title: Automorphism of a group
concepts.description: A bijective group homomorphism from a group to itself; automorphisms form a group under composition.

concepts.title: Jacobi form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concepts.description: A holomorphic function on H×C of weight κ∈(1/2)Z and index m∈(1/2)Z_{≥0}, with a specified compatible finite-image multiplier, transforming by the metaplectic modular weight factor and exp(2πimcz²/(cτ+d)), and by exp(−2πim(r²τ+2rz)) times its multiplier under z↦z+rτ+s. At every cusp its Fourier indices obey 4mn−ℓ²≥0.

concepts.title: Modular form of half-integral weight with a multiplier
concepts.description: For κ∈(1/2)Z, a holomorphic function on the upper half-plane satisfying f(γτ)=χ(γ,φ)φ(τ)^(2κ)f(τ) on the metaplectic preimage of a congruence subgroup, for a fixed compatible finite-image character χ, and holomorphic at every cusp. The multiplier is specified as part of the data.

concepts.title: Hausdorff topological space
concepts.description: A topological space in which any two distinct points have disjoint open neighbourhoods.

concepts.title: Holomorphy of a modular form at a cusp
concepts.description: After applying the weight-k slash action by a matrix sending a cusp to infinity, the resulting periodic function has a Fourier expansion in q_h=exp(2πiτ/h) with no negative powers, where h is the cusp width.

concepts.title: Holomorphic function of several complex variables
concepts.description: A complex function on an open subset of C^n that is locally representable by a convergent power series in the n complex coordinates. Vector-valued holomorphy for a finite-dimensional target means holomorphy of its coordinates in any basis.

concepts.title: Hopf ideal of a commutative Hopf algebra
concepts.description: An ideal I of a commutative Hopf algebra H satisfying Δ(I)⊂I⊗H+H⊗I, ε(I)=0 and S(I)⊂I, so the quotient inherits the Hopf operations.

concepts.title: Idele group of a number field
concepts.description: The restricted product ∏′_v F_v× with respect to O_v× at finite places. As a group it is the unit group of the adele ring, but its restricted-product topology is specified independently rather than taken as the subspace topology from A_F.

concepts.title: Idelic norm
concepts.description: For an idele a=(a_v), |a|_A=∏_v|a_v|_v using the normalized local multiplicative norms; almost all factors are1. This is a continuous homomorphism A_F×→R_{>0}.

concepts.title: Inertia group at a prime of a Galois extension
concepts.description: The subgroup I_w of the decomposition group consisting of automorphisms acting trivially on the residue field at w.
